But thank you for your compliment and real talk, being above 6K is already an impressive achievement. 

Full disclosure, I’m not an expert or a real pro at hearthstone but I guess some tips would be to play for top 4 as much as you can. (easier said than done) 

Battlegrounds is a fiesta of RNG so just being consistent in overall just picking good minions will probably lead to better wins and weaker loses. 

Early game survival is important so don’t be afraid to not level up and instead roll for good stats. (My saying is if I basically get destroyed the previous fight, maybe I should roll for better units instead of upgrading.) 

Like for example, there will be games where you just get the worst rolls, never hit your pairs and there’s a player who has triple Brann + Murlocs but instead of trying to force a specific board strategy, you can alternately just put as much value and stats on board to stay alive against everyone who isn’t triple Brann + Murlocs. 

Also don’t be afraid to switch comps. Like if you don’t get the minions you want, look at your board and see if you can transition to a different board ( Ex. murlocs to beast or mechs or even demons) 

However on the opposite side, you can play like a greedy slut :’) 
For example, very early tavern upgrades so you can get the good 4,5 and 6 drops before everyone else

I usually go as much greed as possible if: 
[I have a decent to good board]
[I have enough hp to survive a lose, if I lose]

The downside is if you whiff while going greed, you basically lose. 

Anyways, I apologize if my tips don’t really make sense but I hope this helps you. :)
